integrity: Proof is self-contained and numerical checks are finite, not a substitute for the all-size argument; no independent review has been performed. The date 2009-12-31 is the earliest day-resolved source publication date confirmed here; an older 2004 paper is known by year but without verified day.
scientific_limitations: Exact last-entrance census for positive three-tap majority shift-feedback; full earlier entrance-time and basin distributions unproved. Stable words were characterized in earlier sequential majority literature. Historical priority of the last-clock enumeration is provisional.
title: Sharp last-entry mass in a rotating majority-feedback ring
